events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The Iran war has escalated, leading to increased tensions in the Middle East. This has resulted in a rise in oil prices and a decrease in stock markets. The US has announced plans to increase its military presence in the region.
events.reasoning: The escalation of the Iran war has led to increased uncertainty in the markets. This has resulted in a decrease in stock prices, making it a good time to buy. However, emerging markets are likely to be negatively impacted, making it a good time to short.

timeFrame.note: Monitor oil prices and US military presence in the region

events.exitStrategy: Exit when oil prices stabilize or US military presence decreases
